# Savage Skincare

> Savage Skincare makes the Lip Pod: a clean, plant-based lip gloss in a refillable case that clips to your phone, bag or wrist so you never lose it. The Lip Pod is in design and open for preorder at $24 (it will be $32 at launch). Every product image on the site is a concept render.

## The Lip Pod

- What it is: a refillable gloss tube that snaps magnetically into a small ivory case with rose-gold hardware. The case clips to a phone strap, a bag or a wrist on a cord.
- Price: $24 founding-member preorder. $32 at launch.
- Shipping: free on every preorder while preorders are open, as a limited-time offer. Shipping normally costs $4.90.
- In the box: the Lip Pod case, a full-size gloss and one refill.
- Refills: $11 for a 3-pack while preorders are open, $15 after launch.
- First run: 500 units. Preorders ship first, before the public launch.
- Status: in design. The concept is done and designers are working on the shape, the clip and the materials. No manufacturer is locked in yet.
- Shipping estimate: early 2027. This is an estimate, not a promise.

## The gloss

- Ingredients: shea butter, squalane, hyaluronic acid, glycerin and vitamin E.
- Plant-based. No fragrance. No parabens. Cruelty-free.
- Sourced organic wherever we can get it.
- The full ingredient list goes on the label, in plain English.
- Cosmetic product. Results vary. Not medical advice.

## Preorder terms and refunds

- You are charged when you order, not when it ships. Checkout is on Shopify.
- Full refund any time before your Pod ships: email hello@savageskincare.com. No reason needed.
- If the shipping estimate moves, everyone who preordered is emailed and can take a full refund instead of waiting.
- Joining the email list is free and is not an order.
